page.overview:
Who is Isengar Took?

Isengar Took was a Hobbit of the Shire and one of the many uncles of Bilbo Baggins.

Isengar was the eleventh and youngest child of Gerontius Took and Adamanta Chubb. He came from a large family of eleven other brothers and sisters: Isengrim, Hildigard, Isumbras, Hildigrim, Hildifons, Isembard, Hildibrand, Belladonna, Donnamira, and Mirabella. He is not recorded to have married or have had any children, but is said to have 'gone to sea' in his youth.
